purpose: 현재 업무 상황을 읽기 전용 live evidence로 파악하고 한 화면에 정리한다.

preparation: identify exact scope, actors, repositories, servers, jobs, records and evidence timestamps
separate historical records from live state
execution: inspect current files, processes, logs, services and handoff records without mutation
classify planned, running, execution-complete, verification-PASS and user-accepted separately
verification: cross-check evidence time, provenance and contradictions
do not call plans or stale logs current
mark inaccessible state unknown rather than guessing
completion: one-screen status, key issue and exactly one next action
record evidence pointers and unknowns without creating redundant reports
